player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in SimpleTak.
On the board, your stones appear as '{player_stone}' and your opponent's stones appear as '{opponent_stone}'.

On your turn, choose one empty cell (by its numbered index) and place your stone there.
For example, '[12]' places your stone in cell 12.

Your objective is to form a continuous path of your stones that connects two opposite edges of the board (top-to-bottom or left-to-right).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Uimhir chealla neamhbhailí {cell_num}. Ní mór go mbeadh sé idir 0 agus {max_board_num} .
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Tá cealla {cell_num} á n-ocáid cheana féin. Roghnaigh cill folamh.

action.placement: Chuir Imreoir {current_player_id} a shiombail ({symbol}) i gcill {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Chuir Imreoir {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') dhá imeall urchomhaireacha le chéile!
outcome.draw: Tá an bord lán. Is tarraingt é!
